changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: create or alter view [security].TypeLevelOwners as select r.Id as RuleId, r.Uid as RuleUid, r.RoleId, ro.Uid as RoleUid, ro.Name as RoleName, ro.[Permissions], r.AssetTypeId, r.SecurityType, r_then.SecurityId, r.IsOverride, r.IsVisible from [security].[Rule] r inner join [security].[Role] ro on ro.Id = r.RoleId and r.ApplyToType = 1 -- ROLE inner join [security].RuleThen r_then on r_then.Id = r.Id -- THEN
